title: Claude Code usage analytics & cost tracking | Aimeterly
excerpt: See how your organization uses Claude Code — usage, estimated cost, productivity, and audit logs by user. No infrastructure to run; live in 5 minutes.
content_html:
Managed monitoring for Claude Code

See how your organization uses Claude Code —
on a dashboard within 5 minutes of use.

No infrastructure to run. Distribute one settings snippet and get usage, estimated cost, and productivity visibility across your organization and users — a managed SaaS for admins and engineering managers.

No credit card required · 14-day Pro trial · Drops to the Free plan automatically afterwards

Key features

From adoption to cost, productivity, and governance

Usage

DAU / WAU / MAU, sessions, and tokens by model — broken down by organization and user. See how deeply AI is being adopted at a glance.

Cost visibility

Estimated cost (API-equivalent pricing) by user and model, with period-over-period comparison. Spot heavy users and models, and ground budget decisions.

Productivity

Track lines of code, commits, PRs, and suggestion acceptance rate over time — the material you need to explain the ROI of your AI investment.

Audit log

Record and search prompts and file edits — only when your organization enables it. Opt-in by design, to meet governance requirements.

Set up in 3 steps

1

Sign up

Create your organization account and get a dedicated endpoint and ingest token issued instantly.

2

Distribute the snippet

Just paste the snippet into your Claude Team / Enterprise admin console, or distribute it as managed-settings.json. No extra development required.

3

Check the dashboard

As people start using Claude Code, data appears within 5 minutes.

Your data

Designed to be trusted with sensitive data

No content by default

By default we collect user and team identifiers (such as email addresses and user IDs) plus usage metrics like models and token counts. Prompt and response content is never sent until your organization enables the corresponding capture type.

Never used for training, never sold

Your data is used solely to power your organization's dashboards. We do not use it to train machine-learning models or sell it to third parties.

Automatic deletion by retention

Access is controlled per organization. Data past your plan's retention window is deleted automatically, and if you delete your organization, collected data is deleted within 30 days.

Card details stay with Stripe

Payments are processed by Stripe; we never store your card details.

Read the privacy policy →

Frequently asked questions

What data is sent by default?

Usage metadata: user identifiers (such as email addresses and user IDs), team attributes, models, token counts, and estimated cost. Prompt, response, and tool input/output content is not sent by default — it is recorded only for capture types your organization explicitly enables.

How is this different from Anthropic's built-in usage analytics?

Aimeterly gives you one dashboard with detailed breakdowns by organization, user, and model, productivity metrics (lines of code, commits, PRs, acceptance rate), an opt-in audit log, and search across your plan's retention window. Data appears within 5 minutes of use, so you can see adoption from day one.

Which Claude Code environments are supported?

Aimeterly works in environments where you can distribute settings via the Claude Team / Enterprise admin console (server-managed settings) or as a managed-settings.json file. It requires only that you can configure where Claude Code sends its OpenTelemetry telemetry.

Are the costs shown what I get billed?

No. They are estimates converted from telemetry at API-equivalent pricing and may differ from billing by Anthropic or your cloud providers. Use them to compare users and spot trends.

What happens when the free trial ends?

Your organization moves to the Free plan automatically and nothing is charged — no credit card is required for the trial or the Free plan. Upgrade whenever you need Pro's higher limits and longer retention.

Can I cancel or delete my data?

Paid plans can be canceled anytime, and paid features remain available until the end of the billing period. Deleting your organization deletes collected data within 30 days, and data past the retention window is deleted automatically.

常见问题

What data is sent by default?

使用元数据：用户标识符（例如电子邮件地址和用户 ID）、团队属性、模型、代币计数和估计成本。 默认情况下不发送提示、响应和工具输入/输出内容 - 仅针对您的组织明确启用的捕获类型记录这些内容。

How is this different from Anthropic's built-in usage analytics?

Aimeterly 为您提供一个仪表板，其中按组织、用户和模型、生产力指标（代码行数、提交、PR、接受率）、选择性加入审核日志以及跨计划保留窗口的搜索进行详细分类。 数据会在使用后 5 分钟内出现，因此您从第一天起就可以看到采用情况。

Which Claude Code environments are supported?

Aimeterly 在您可以通过 Claude Team / Enterprise 管理控制台（服务器管理的设置）或作为 Managed-settings.json 文件分发设置的环境中工作。 它仅要求您可以配置 Claude Code 发送其 OpenTelemetry 遥测数据的位置。

Are the costs shown what I get billed?

不会。它们是按 API 等效定价从遥测数据转换而来的估算值，可能与 Anthropic 或您的云提供商的计费有所不同。 使用它们来比较用户并发现趋势。

What happens when the free trial ends?

您的组织会自动转移到免费计划，并且不收取任何费用 - 试用或免费计划不需要信用卡。 当您需要 Pro 更高的限制和更长的保留时间时，请升级。

Can I cancel or delete my data?

付费计划可以随时取消，并且付费功能在计费周期结束之前仍然可用。 删除您的组织会在 30 天内删除收集的数据，并且超过保留期限的数据将被自动删除。
